message: Hi, I'm a student with a full stack certification background. My overall academic average is 76.8% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in cloud computing and developer. I want to become a Software Systems Engineer. My family can afford at most about USD 1200 per year. I live in Pune. I cannot leave my city. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

constraints.career_goal: Software Systems Engineer (interested in cloud computing and developer roles)

explanation:
This MTech in Computer Networks aligns perfectly with your interest in cloud computing and developer roles. It is located in Pune, requires a CS background (which you have), and offers a strong median starting salary of $10359.

The MSc Software Engineering program is highly relevant to your goal of becoming a Software Systems Engineer. It is in Pune, has a good placement rate (84%), and the tuition ($1450) is within your budget.

While focused on cybersecurity, this MSc program offers strong technical skills that complement cloud computing knowledge. It meets all your constraints (Pune location, affordable tuition) and provides a solid median starting salary of $10236.

This MSc in Software Quality Engineering is a good fit for developer roles, focusing on system reliability. It is located in Pune and has an affordable tuition fee ($1250), making it budget-friendly while still offering relevant skills.

Although focused on design/HCI, this program is the most affordable option ($900) and remains in Pune. It provides a strong foundation for understanding user-facing systems, which can be valuable when aiming to become a well-rounded Software Systems Engineer.
